title: Picture vision batches are not cut off after 60 s: the per-call ceiling is ten minutes
steps: S1: Run the picture-vision and picture-vision-risk-labels test files one at a time with --test-concurrency=1.
expect: S1: every test reports ok, including the batch, refusal, pool and p6 risk-label tests.
S2: CALL_MS is 600_000 and is the only deadline on the vision call path.
evidence: On dev, 8 of 19 photos failed with reason timeout twice in a row after the p6 prompt added three questions per picture
fence: The vision call path keeps working end to end with the longer ceiling; the ceiling itself is a constant that no test waits on

tests: one call per batch: every picture is introduced by its id
a batch the model refuses or garbles costs that batch only
p6 asks whether a picture shows another business
